description: This skill should be used when outbound network calls fail intermittently and need bounded retries with exponential delay and jitter.
patch_rejection_reason: The ship skill covers release preparation, not the retry policy of arbitrary outbound calls, so a patch would bury it.
when_to_use: A flaky upstream returns transient errors
A request storm follows a brief outage
steps: Cap the attempt count and the total wait
Log each retry with its attempt number
sharp_edges: Never retry a request that changes state without an idempotency key
A retry without a cap hides an outage
merge_retire_candidates: Retire this skill if a workflow skill grows a retry section
